[[File:Gaiden Camo.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Camouflaged in a cloak of fancloth]]
'''Fancloth''' is a synthetic fabric that duplicates its surroundings for a total camouflage effect.{{ref|{{twotc}}, fancloth}} [[Warders]]' [[Color-shifting cloak|cloaks]] are made of fancloth. It is manufactured with a [[fancloth ter'angreal|specific]] ''[[ter'angreal]]'' in the [[White Tower]]. In the [[Age of Legends]] fancloth was considered stylish. During the [[War of Power]] soldiers wore it.{{ref/book|2|26}} "[[Moridin|The Watcher]]" covers himself completely with fancloth so he cannot be seen.{{ref/book|7|20}}
